configurations.raw: pre-registered: every k-gram with >= 20 runs on each side
configurations.nosubmit: raw, with the submit action AND the terminal action removed; this is the configuration lambda is read from, because it keeps a wide, mostly-null motif set
configurations.nosubmit_band: nosubmit, restricted to motifs with prevalence in [0.10, 0.90]; this is the configuration the survivor catalogue is read from, because a motif present in 95% of runs tests whether the other 5% are degenerate
